title: On Enjoying the last warm days of autumn
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：enjoy　|　正文 361 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 enjoy 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the nurse ① enjoyed the last warm days of autumn on the same day, and every sufferer in the ward said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the nurse ② enjoys the last warm days of autumn before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ enjoy the last warm days of autumn at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ enjoyed the last warm days of autumn before — a line in the report for April 1949 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Enjoying the last warm days of autumn on the same day, the nurse said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ enjoy the respect of the whole parish before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Enjoy the respect of the whole parish at once and never mention it again.

By 1962 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new sufferer from the next ward ⑧ enjoys the respect of the whole parish on the same day every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cupboard, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ enjoyed the last warm days of autumn again when nobody else would.

⑩ To enjoy the last warm days of autumn, my mother said in 1967, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the ward remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the ward forgets, somebody enjoys the last warm days of autumn before dawn again and somebody must enjoy the last warm days of autumn on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 享受（一般过去式 enjoyed the last warm days of autumn：1955 年护士头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 享受（一般现在 enjoys the last warm days of autumn：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 享受（不定式 to enjoy the last warm days of autumn：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 享受（过去完成时 had enjoyed the last warm days of autumn：1949 年四月的护理记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 享受（动名词 enjoying the last warm days of autumn 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 享有（enjoy the respect of the whole parish：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去享有受到整个教区的敬重）
G. v. 享有（enjoy the respect of the whole parish：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 享受（后段两处：新来的病患照例 enjoys the respect of the whole parish，而母亲又一次 enjoyed the last warm days of autumn）

answers.why: enjoy 意为“享受”，1955 年护士当天就享受享受秋日最后几个暖天，那是病房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 enjoyed。
enjoy 意为“享受”，自那以后护士天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 enjoys。
enjoy 意为“享受”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯享受享受秋日最后几个暖天”，此处为不定式 to enjoy the last warm days of autumn。
enjoy 意为“享受”，护理记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 1962 年之前就有人享受过，故用过去完成时 had enjoyed。
enjoy 意为“享受”，护士说“享受享受秋日最后几个暖天这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 enjoying the last warm days of autumn 作主语。
enjoy 意为“享有”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去享有受到整个教区的敬重”，should ever 之后用原形 enjoy the respect of the whole parish。
enjoy 意为“享有”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻享有受到整个教区的敬重（enjoy the respect of the whole parish at once），以后再也不要提起。
enjoy 意为“享受”，新来的病患每个夜晚都照例享有受到整个教区的敬重，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 enjoys。
enjoy 意为“享受”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就享受享受秋日最后几个暖天，用一般过去式 enjoyed 叙述。
enjoy 意为“享受”，结尾那句是母亲 1967 年的话：要享受享受秋日最后几个暖天，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和病房记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 enjoy 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the nurse enjoyed the last warm days of autumn on the same day, and nobody in the ward forgot it.
Even now the nurse enjoys the last warm days of autumn before dawn whenever the ward asks.
Enjoying the last warm days of autumn on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever enjoy the respect of the whole parish before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sufferer from the next ward enjoys the respect of the whole parish on the same day every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother enjoyed the last warm days of autumn again, and the ward remembered that half.
